status: Post-hoc mechanism and robustness analysis of 120 previously inspected scenarios; locally locked before new executions, not a new holdout or external preregistration.
controls: One exact composite SPC construction per scenario, immutable shared starts, independent reservation indices. All reinsertion uses WSR pressure and evaluation weights 3/2/1, original lexicographic key, current individual delay cap, candidate enumeration and 50-pass cap. Preserve fallback. F/T/D/ALL add current-plan service guards only. D protects horizontal and vertical distance separately. T plus ground-delay protection implies F; no double counting independent restrictions.
logging: One compressed event per flight visit: earliest feasible step for every structural template (-1 if none within current cap), all improving candidates with multi-label violations and service deltas, counts of infeasible/non-improving/improving, best unguarded candidate and best allowed candidate for every guard. Improvement is relative to current plan, not enumeration-dependent running best. Accepted replacements and strict delay reductions are separate. Full candidate fields reconstructible from immutable template index and step.
shadow: At every WSR visit evaluate F/T/D/ALL on exactly the same state without mutating WSR; best-blocked, alternative-available and fully-blocked opportunities use visits with at least one otherwise feasible strict-key improvement as denominator. Policy trajectories reported separately. Candidate counts are not independent statistical samples or causal contributions; inspect exact overlapping masks.

analysis.unit: Whole paired scenario, networks separate; descriptive pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, no new confirmatory p-values
analysis.endpoints: Final W, per-scenario 100*(W_SPC-W_method)/W_SPC recovery, paired loss versus WSR, absolute savings, accepted and strict delay updates, passes and caps, flight service means/deltas/worse proportions and positive-delta tails.
analysis.retention: 100*sum(W_SPC-W_method)/sum(W_SPC-W_WSR), ratio of aggregate gains, not mean individual ratios. Paired bootstrap; undefined denominator recorded. Separately count zero WSR gain scenarios.
analysis.mechanism: Per-network exact mask counts and opportunity categories, scenario-level rates with zero-opportunity scenarios marked undefined; report numerator and denominator. Common-state candidates grouped by route/layer/lane/speed revisions and service-delta magnitudes; witness rule earliest seed/pass/visit/candidate within each network and violation bit. Network size is confounded with load and request-window configuration.
analysis.failures: Preserve every prescribed scenario and outcome; no replacements, no favorable-only unconditional claims. Zero W_SPC gives recovery zero only if target also zero; otherwise undefined. Pass cap is not convergence.
analysis.timing: Sequential one-host runs, native pools limited to one, rotate branch order by seed; log shared preparation/construction separately. Instrumented runtime is descriptive and not compared to uninstrumented historical timings.

verification: Before lock: adversarial guard/multi-label/statistical tests, small development parity against original unguarded and joint solvers, logging-enabled/disabled parity. Formal: 360 SPC/WSR/ALL archived parity, all shared starts/inputs, log conservation and independent event reconstruction, every accepted update strict key/current delay/active service/resource checks, final speed/capacity/independent nominal geometry. Preserve prior evidence and manuscript hashes.
scope: No new construction objective, pressure policy, initial-only cap, LNS comparison, energy estimate or topology-only causal claim. Manuscript starts from minor_step8_construction.
